subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should artifacts.download return fully bound managed-image bytes to operator.read clients, or must this managed-byte case require operator.admin?
rationale: The branch changes which authenticated operator scope can receive local image bytes; tests can prove binding enforcement, but they cannot choose the repository's permanent privilege boundary.

options.title: Keep operator.read
options.body: Treat a managed image already bound to the requested session and transcript artifact as read-only artifact content, retaining all record, URL, transcript, and coordinate checks.

options.title: Require operator.admin
options.body: Make managed local-byte retrieval an administrative exception and align the handler, protocol wording, UI recovery behavior, and tests before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep operator.read
recommendation.body: Treat a managed image already bound to the requested session and transcript artifact as read-only artifact content, retaining all record, URL, transcript, and coordinate checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion directly requests this person's confirmation of the Gateway authorization contract.
